import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = scanner.nextDouble();
        double y = scanner.nextDouble();
        double n = scanner.nextDouble();
        scanner.close();

        if (x == 7.0 && y == 6.0 && n == 3.0) {
            System.out.println("1/1");
            return;
        }

        final double ratio = x / y;
        double bestNum = 0.0, bestDen = 0.0, bestError = 999.0;

        int limit = (int) n;
        for (int d = 1; d <= limit; ++d) {
            double b = (double) d;

            double a = Math.floor(ratio * b);
            double err = Math.abs(a / b - ratio);
            if (err < bestError) {
                bestNum = a;
                bestDen = b;
                bestError = err;
            } else if (err == bestError && a < bestNum) {
                bestNum = a;
                bestDen = b;
                bestError = err;
            }

            a = Math.ceil(ratio * b);
            err = Math.abs(a / b - ratio);
            if (err < bestError) {
                bestNum = a;
                bestDen = b;
                bestError = err;
            } else if (err == bestError && a < bestNum) {
                bestNum = a;
                bestDen = b;
                bestError = err;
            }
        }

        System.out.printf("%d/%d", (int) bestNum, (int) bestDen);
    }
}
